input.requirements: normalize accepts a string, trims leading/trailing whitespace, lowercases letters, preserves internal whitespace, and returns empty for all-whitespace strings. Non-string inputs throw TypeError. Use independent exact expectations.

context.content: export function normalize(s){if(typeof s!=='string')throw new TypeError();return s.trim().toLowerCase();}
